description: Claude Code as a bare stateless engine node — the same three wakes as engine-claude, invoked with --permissions bypass, which for claude is --permission-mode bypassPermissions: the node runs without prompting, and deny rules in settings.json still apply. An unrestricted node acts on untrusted inbound mail — anyone who can reach its inbox, including over a broker or a shared folder, is driving a CLI that will not ask. Only for an agent on its own machine and its own account.
